scope: Current Xenoverse 2 provenance and mechanics refresh for four Ki Blast Ultimate research records.

records.name: Blaster Stream
evidence: Dedicated skill page states PQ148 unlock, Ki Blast/Ultimate taxonomy, 300 Ki, Kale (Super Saiyan 2) and Kefla (Super Saiyan) Customize Partner users.
Character reference independently lists Blaster Stream on Kale (Super Saiyan 2).
Mechanics source states the move is chargeable and fires a second Ki Wave after a successful first beam.

records.name: Brave Heat
evidence: Dedicated skill page states Bardock training unlock, Ki Blast/Ultimate taxonomy, 300 Ki, and Bardock user.
Mentor reference lists Brave Heat as Bardock's fourth lesson reward.
Bardock character data lists Brave Heat in a preset and Custom Partner Ultimate list.

records.name: Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage
evidence: Dedicated skill page states PQ46 unlock, Ki Blast/Ultimate taxonomy, 300 Ki, and Krillin user.
Ultimate Attack table independently lists PQ46 and 300 Ki.
Unblockable Attack reference includes Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage among unblockable attacks; the dedicated page describes five discs.

records.name: Circle Flash
evidence: Dedicated skill page states PQ154 unlock, Ki Blast/Ultimate taxonomy, 300 Ki, and Dyspo user.
DLC 13 reference includes Circle Flash among the pack's ten new skills and PQ154 among its four quests.
Dyspo character data lists Circle Flash in his current preset.
